svg.title: Kafka SSL and SASL security settings flow between client and broker
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing how security.protocol, ssl.keystore, ssl.truststore, sasl.mechanism, sasl.jaas.config, sasl.kerberos.service.name, sasl.login.callback.handler.class, and ssl.endpoint.identification.algorithm relate and flow between Kafka client and broker
